homeMobileGuide1: Click floating button to start recording
homeTipsCapture1: Drag HAR files directly into the Reqable window to open.
homeTipsCapture2: Use %1 to view the traffic item in a new window.
homeTipsCapture3: Want to keep the traffic data? Save as HAR and open next time.
homeTipsCapture4: Reqable mobile app can send traffic here without Wi-Fi proxy.
homeTipsCapture5: Need a new traffic list? Right-click the tab to create a new session.
homeTipsCapture6: Conflict with other proxy tools? Try Reqable's secondary proxy.
homeTipsCapture7: SSL Proxying can control the decryption and display of SSL traffic.
homeTipsCapture8: Too much traffic in list? Try quick filtering by device, app, and domain in the sidebar.
homeTipsCapture9: Traffic list search conditions can be saved as presets for next time.
homeTipsCapture10: Right-click highlight menu can preset conditions to automatically highlight matching traffic.
homeTipsRest1: Enable follow traffic %1, and view raw messages of REST in traffic list.
homeTipsRest2: You can paste cURL commands directly in the API request input field.
homeTipsView1: Font too small or too large? Try %1 or %2 to adjust the zoom ratio.
homeTipsView2: Not satisfied with the default color scheme? Customize it in the settings!
homeTipsView3: Want to focus more? Try %1 to enter or exit Zen mode.
homeTipsSelection1: Select a URL and right-click to generate a QR code.
homeTipsSelection2: Select a URL and right-click to open it in your default browser.
homeTipsSelection3: Select a URL and right-click to create a new API tab.
homeTipsSelection4: Select a JSON and right-click to prettify and view it in a new window.
homeTipsSelection5: Select a Base64 or JWT data and right-click to decode it.
homeTipsScript1: Environment variables can be read and written in Python scripts.
homeTipsScript2: Don't want to write script yourself? Try looking for some in the template repository.
homeTipsScript3: Python scripts can be saved as templates for quick use next time.
homeTipsScript4: Python script template is too verbose? Try switching to the minimalist template.
homeTipsClipboardQuickCreate: Right-click the `+` on the tab bar to quickly create an HTTP request from clipboard.
homeTipsOfflineMode: Concerned about data security or privacy? Try switching data mode to Offline Mode.
homeDowngradeTitle: DO NOT DOWNGRADE THE APPLICATION VERSION!
homeDowngradeMessage: Downgrading the application may cause data loss or abnormal application behavior.
appExitDoubleBack: Press again to exit the app
